cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2, ether type) with two prominent buffers, Coco-Glucoside (3) and Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4), and no reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Refatting/conditioning routes (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil 6, Glyceryl Oleate 8) argue toward milder feel but do not move the C1 convention.
cleansingStrength.blindToFinal: unchanged from frozen blind formula pass (claims cannot set or move this property, 3.2)

conditioningLevel.rationale: W-RICH holds: prominent payload_lipid Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil (6) converges with cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (9); Section 6 says W-RICH alone counts as a rich architecture for conditioning. Supported by weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate (8) and humectants Glycerin (12), Panthenol (13), Sodium Hyaluronate (18).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: C2 is not fully met: no pearlizing/fatty route separate from the lipid that substitutes for the silicone; no silicone; lipid sits after Sodium Chloride, so its amount may be small.
conditioningLevel.blindToFinal: unchanged from frozen blind formula pass (claims cannot set or move this property, 3.2)

weightPotential.rationale: Waxy payload lipid (6) plus cationic guar (9) plus weak refatter (8) plausibly leave bounded residue; W-RICH is present but resetCapacity is moderate (C1 chassis), so the limited-reset route to high is not met.
weightPotential.blindToFinal: unchanged from frozen blind formula pass (claims cannot set or move this property, 3.2)

excluded: Sorbitan Caprylate (10): preservative booster/emulsifier, not a deposition route

depositionLoad.rationale: Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil (6) prominent waxy lipid + Guar HPTC (9) + Glyceryl Oleate (8); no silicone, no second cationic.

persistence.rationale: Hydrogenated (waxy) lipid is more substantive than a liquid oil; guar deposits with the lipid; no silicone/film former.

resetCapacity.rationale: SLES with glucoside and betaine buffers (C1 moderate): effective ordinary cleansing.

weightRecord.counterevidence: Not high: W-RICH without limited reset (resetCapacity moderate); only one cationic polymer, no silicone, film former or second persistent system. Not low: two deposition families (waxy lipid + guar) converge and are prominent (W2).
weightRecord.whyThisBand: One plausibly persistent lipid+cationic system converges (W-RICH) so lightweight would understate residue; ordinary sulfate reset bounds it.
weightRecord.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH without limited reset (resetCapacity moderate); only one cationic polymer, no silicone, film former or second persistent system. Not low: two deposition families (waxy lipid + guar) converge and are prominent (W2).
weightRecord.confidenceLimitingFactor: Amount of Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil after salt is unknown; W-RICH vs moderate reset is a realistic one-step uncertainty toward high.
weightRecord.claimsEffect: Claims read after freeze; none changes the band (6.5 step 5).
